text: Baseline (local-full, full precision, n=200, seed 1): the model's top token equals the dataset answer on 17% of inputs; chance for 5 symbols is 20%. Mean logit diff -0.025 (corrupt: -0.03). Pre-registered prediction (accuracy >= 0.95) REFUTED. The per-prompt logit diffs are exactly -1, 0 or +1, so the model does emit a crisp one-hot-like output, but that output is unrelated to the dataset's answer labels. The premise 'the answers are the model's own outputs' does not hold for this dataset. E0001 inspection also found no consistent input->label rule (e.g. the same multiset-level features map to different labels).

Stop per protocol step 1: the model does not do the behaviour defined by the dataset (accuracy 0.17 ~ chance 0.20, E0002). There is no dataset-defined mechanism to explain, so no circuit search, no predict() and no verify_hypothesis: any circuit reported against these labels would be a false discovery. Report as a null result. 2 of 25 experiments used.
